title: S4-NEW-16 — A pan is never a stroke.
goal: Zooming in, zooming out and Fit never change the artwork or add history, and afterwards a click at the centre of the 16 x 16 canvas still paints exactly native pixel (8,8) (independent digest f99d82e7); Undo restores the original.

steps.why: Navigating the view is not an edit.
The click lands on native pixel (8,8): the digest equals an independently computed white field with one blue pixel there.

cliOnly: middle-button panning and wheel zoom, which need pointer gestures (tests/production/drawingResponse.spec.ts, tests/production/inputOwnership.spec.ts)
